# IITPAVE Test Fixtures Directory

This directory contains synthetic sample output files used strictly for unit testing the `IITPAVEOutputParser` and `ParityRunner` infrastructure.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **No Parity Claims:**
> The files in this folder are **synthetic samples** and do **NOT** represent official validation data or prove general IITPAVE solver parity.
> Official benchmark output files must be added in future phases to perform real engineering validations.
